name: Hiura Shiori
source:
She has a very shy personality and is always nervous in front of people.

Deep down, she is a student teacher who wants to become a great teacher who doesn't get nervous.

She is very opinionated, easily deceived, weak to pressure, and easily swayed. She
is quite naive, and is often annoyed by those around her.

She likes "famous quotes" from great people and celebrities, and tries to insert them in the middle of conversations.
